notes.title: EchoBlade 1.5.0 - Update Notes
notes.notes:
Version 1.5.0
-----------------------------------------
Key Holders that are attached to a wall will no longer glow after the key has been picked up

Additional sound effects have been added when blocking an attack

Perk menu has been adjusted to cause less confusion. Transparency of some icons have been adjusted. New sound effect are also present.

Fixed issue with perks not applying after unlocking them

Fixed issue with ESC key not working as intended within certain menus

Adjusted experience curve to level up character

Fixed issue with duplicate skill points being awarded

Fixed issue with player not being able to pick up keys from dead guards

Fixed issue with arrows not applying damage immediately after contact

notes.title: EchoBlade 1.4.0 - Update Notes
notes.notes:
Version 1.4.0
-----------------------------------------
EchoKnight now carries 8 arrows by default.

More arrows can be found in various levels.

A lot of alcoves have been removed from various levels.

Some larger rooms have been decreased in size to avoid the player from getting lost.

More environment objects (benches, altars, chandeliers, pillars, torches, rock piles, buckets, medieval torture devices, chains, breakable barrels, breakable walls) have been added to all levels. 

A smoother echo effect has been applied for the torches. 

The echo effect from jumping has been reduced.

Slightly tweaked double tap input for controllers to require more precision

Various voice lines have been adjusted

Healing will activate quicker when not moving

Fast travel map has been updated to show if a Main Gate Key has been picked up from each level or not. If the selected level is highlighted with gold, there is still a key to pick up!

notes.title: EchoBlade Version 1.3.0
notes.notes:
Version 1.3.0
-----------------------------------------

- Fixed perk menu icons being transparent after you have unlocked said perk

- NPC in the Barracks and Dungeoon Great Hall level now uses his inside voice instead of yelling

- Skill tree has been cleaned up more

- Level up perk prompt now stays on the screen slightly longer

- Fixed order of fast travel menu

- The beginning of Dungeon Great Hall has been altered slightly

notes.title: EchoBlade Patch 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

 Localized in 7 additional languages! Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Chinese, Korean, and Japanese
 Fixed glitches occurring with the Main Menu and Fast Travel menu using a controller
 Fixed glitches with the Load Game Menu
 Barrels are now breakable and more of them have been added to various levels
 Enemy sightlines have been reduced to encourage more stealth opportunities
 Enemies holding a key have a larger collision box to prevent the key from not being able to be picked up after their demise
 Player's "Quick Noise" distance has been improved but will fade quicker. There are additional sound effects as well.
 "The Lost Chamber" level has been slightly modified to prevent confusing backtracking
 Modified Fast Travel map to show where Main Gate Keys are located
 Fast Travel Menu will now show current location highlighted in red
 Hitting enemies now produces some slight screen shake
 Adjusted some tutorial prompts
 Skill tree menu has been cleaned up a little bit
 Health Regen will only activate if the character stops moving for a few seconds
 Echo effects from torches have been modified
 Walking echo distance has been slightly decreased
 Added a slight delay to enemies attacks after they make a grunting noise
 Increased amount of rats and the noises they make........so please stop asking for more rats.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 is here!
notes.notes:
Been adding lots of new stuff to the game after getting some feedback from other players and just some other things I wanted to add but didn't get time to before releasing the game.

Enjoy the new update!

Version 1.1.0
-----------------------------------------

- Fixed trapdoor leading to infinite abyss in West Dungeon

- Basic enemy damage animations have been altered. Enemies now step backwards and have less "stunned" time

- Giant spike ball will only do damage if it is rolling

- The "Trickster"'s voice lines have been fixed after killing or not killing him

- Fixed subtitles clearing too early

- Fading on default HUD health and stamina bars are now an exponential function instead of a linear function

- Fixed bug where Claborn was able to get out of his cell

- Perk menu now disables items you have already unlocked

- Fixed navigation issue in Perk menu for keyboard and controllers

- New voice actor for NPC that talks about poison

- New voice actor for NPC that talks about lava and stairs

- Slightly increased enemy opacity

- "Keys" in settings has been renamed to "Key Bindings"

- Page Up and Page Down have been added to list of bindable keys

- Spike trap will produce an echo effect before launching spikes

- Echoes have a slighter harder edge to their texture

- Rocks produce less and smaller echoes

- A few rooms in Level 1 have been made smaller

- The first gate in Level 2 has been moved up to prevent players from getting lost

- Toggle Sprint option has been added in Settings -> Controls

- Added HUD message that displays when the player is entering the next area

- Running and walking echo distance has been slight decreased

- Click noise echo fades a lot quicker

- A new exit appears in Level 5 to gain access to 5 new levels!

- Added a new NPC by the main gate!

- Piles of Bones have been added throughout the levels
